claim_boundary: This post hoc analysis varies only the history-sufficiency threshold and root-success rule. It does not establish invariance of individual cell labels, QELM emulation labels, representation-limited labels, unresolved labels, or measurement-limited labels. A censored value of 7 means only that no tested window d<=6 reaches the specified rule.

data_scope.right_censored_window_meaning: no tested window d<=6 reaches the rule

supported_statement: Across the tested two-, three-, and four-qubit local-loss cohorts, all 27 post hoc measured history-sufficiency frontiers are non-increasing over the sampled loss grid when the NRMSE tolerance is varied over 0.08, 0.10, and 0.12 and the root-success rule over 9, 10, and 11 of 12.
